A 46-year-old male bus driver with a history of hypertension and diabetes presents with back pain that
he describes as an achy sensation, rated 5 out of 10, which has progressively worsened over the past
few months. During osteopathic structural examination, restricted motion is observed in the T1–T6
region when the patient bends forward, reaches behind himself, or leans to the left. What is the most
likely diagnosis for the motion restriction in T1–T6? Answer Choices: (A) FSLRR (B) NSLRR (C)
FSRRL (D) RSLRR (E) NRSLR (F) NSRRL (G) RSRRL (H) NSRRR (I) NSRLR (J) ESRRL
 A. NRSLR
B. FSLRR
C. NSLRR
D. FSRRL
E. NSRLR
F. RSRRL
G. NSRRR
H. NSRRL
I. ESRRL
J. RSLRR
